description: PhotoCraft: An open-source, photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust

latest_release.name: PhotoCraft v0.21.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Save the flattened document at full size into .pcraft files as an option by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9913
* Add guarded scratch storage and owned memory supervision by @vistaero in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5330
* Save: stop doubling the encoded file in memory (#6607) by @VishnuByrraju in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8115
* Stream native PSD/PSB and EXR imports through bounded bands by @vistaero in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5331
* Size PSD import memory limits from available RAM by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10897
* Portable mode: create the write probe exclusively, never through an existing entry by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10963
* codecs: refuse EXR preview attributes larger than their value by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10982
* security(affinity): charge allocation records, empty subpaths, paint lists, tile indexes and shape lookups by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10966
* Stream GPU viewport pages with bounded staging and cancellation by @vistaero in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5332
* fix(ui): Save for Web Matte takes only whole colours while typed (#8830) by @hnoerenberg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8890
* test(ui): pin the options-bar swatch's rounded checker clip (#8741) by @hnoerenberg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8898
* fix(ui): the Stroke Path dialog remembers Simulate Pressure (#10527) by @hnoerenberg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10583
* fix(plugins): the install error names the format the file actually is (#10362) by @hnoerenberg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10633
* fix(ui): Ctrl+Alt + wheel zooms the canvas like Alt + wheel (#10488) by @hnoerenberg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10517
* TIFF Options: compression, image pyramid and Save Transparency (#8827) by @Yuki-init in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10932
* fix(ui): Minimum and Maximum preview at the scale they apply (#10474) by @hnoerenberg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10524
* Type: add OpenType Numerals submenu (figure styles) by @tareq-halaby in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11051
* fix(ui): Roundness previews its radius within 1 px, and a held frame survives a factor change (#10474) by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11081
* fix(ui): Overscroll off keeps an image smaller than the window centred (#10488) by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11085
* Don't auto-select off-canvas layers from the pasteboard (#10665) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10731
* Integrate streamed PSB saves with the shared save service by @vistaero in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5333
* Integration batch 13: 13 parity epic PRs on main by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10952
* Record actions in a document-independent form (#219) [depends on #4496] by @FabioLissi in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4514
* Batch: subfolders, open documents, file naming, stop on error, error log, progress and cancel (#219) by @FabioLissi in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4579
* Layers panel: the filter row lists linked, missing or embedded smart objects by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9211
* Layers panel: filter by Color, as in Photoshop (#5898) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10439
* Layers panel: show the filter row in every theme by @Psychotoxical in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10752
* Support newer recorded Action events by @yoriswind in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10755
* Actions: support direct Gradient Map and Lab-range Replace Color by @yoriswind in https://git

detail.readme_excerpt:
PhotoCraft

Image editing; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop, rebuilt in pure Rust.
Layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes and real PSD files,
in a native app written entirely in Rust. Open source, offline, and yours.


PhotoCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps
